subject: Re: Quick follow-up from our discovery call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam@zenith.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from our discovery call

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Zenith's inference needs. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps: 

- Key challenges you mentioned: unpredictable latency at peak, cost of embedding pipelines, and the need for on-prem options for sensitive data.
- Redwood fit: our Dedicated pools + prefix caching can address tail-latency spikes; Optimize recommendations reduce token unit cost by ~20% on similar workloads; Private deployments support your compliance needs.

Action items we discussed:
1) I’ll share a short product overview + SOW draft that maps to the pilot scope (attached).
2) You’ll align with infra and security (Priya + team) and share a list of P0 requirements and target QPS.
3) Tentative next step: 30–45m technical review w/ infra + security to validate network/KMS constraints.

Proposed times: Wed 8/12 10am PT or Thu 8/13 2pm PT — which works for your group?

Attaching: Redwood-Prod-Overview.pdf (2pp) and Proposed-SOW-Zenith.docx (starter SOW).

If useful I can also pull together a short cost/latency projection once you confirm expected QPS and seq lengths.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

--
